name: scheduler-test

store.description: Execute a command and record the result

consoles:
cleanup-temp:
  signature: scheduler-test:cleanup-temp
  description: Deletes temporary files older than 24h
  schedule: '0 * * * *'
  body: ''

generate-report:
  signature: scheduler-test:generate-report
  description: Generates a daily activity report
  schedule: '0 8 * * *'
  body: ''

ping-health:
  signature: scheduler-test:ping-health
  description: Pings all services and records health status
  schedule: '0-59/5 * * * *'
  body: ''

sync-data:
  signature: scheduler-test:sync-data
  description: Syncs data from external source
  schedule: '0-59/15 * * * *'
  body: ''
